# .rice — Copilot Global Instructions

## Ecosystem

This is a monorepo called `.rice`. Each directory has a dedicated agent role described in `.github/instructions/*.md`. Read the relevant instruction file before working in any directory.

## Documentation — Always Check Before Answering

Copilot does not have MCP. Before answering any question about a library, language, or tool used in this repo, fetch the official documentation to avoid hallucination:

| Domain | Docs |
| --- | --- |
| Go | <https://pkg.go.dev> |
| Elixir | <https://hexdocs.pm> |
| Rust | <https://doc.rust-lang.org> |

## Toolchain

- **Runtime env:** `pixi` — all languages and tools are installed via `pixi.toml`
- **Task runner:** `just` — all commands go through `Justfile`
- **Hooks:** `lefthook` — pre-commit, pre-push
- **CI:** `dagger` — pipeline as code
- **Containers:** `docker-compose.yml` + `.docker/`
- **Updates:** `renovate.json` — dependency automation

## Rules

1. Never edit files generated by MASON (CUE). Modify templates in `infra/` and run `just gen`.
2. Always run `just` tasks — never raw compiler commands.
3. Every agent role is defined in `.github/instructions/*.md` — read it before touching that domain.
4. If unsure about a library API — look it up, do not guess.
